resources.string:
This is the test-data edition of the app, for NTC staff.

It needs three permissions to work.

• Location and phone: to read your live signal and nearby Wi-Fi. Android reports neither without them.
• Notifications: to show that sharing is on.

When you allow them, the app starts sending anonymous signal readings to NTC, one every 15 seconds, and a speed test every 30 minutes while on mobile data (about 8 MB each). It keeps going until you tap Stop on the notification or Stop sharing in Settings. Please also allow the app to run without battery restrictions when asked.
